body: 参考输入图的像素颗粒、有限色板、硬边轮廓和阴影方式，创作一位戴头盔的成年骑手驾驶复古摩托车的侧面全身图。主体完整居中，车轮均可见，白色背景，保持像素风，不照搬参考图人物和车辆，不加入文字、商标或渐变光效。

en.title: Pixel-art motorcycle rider
en.description: Side-view motorcycle rider adapts the synthetic reference palette and blocky outline while changing the vehicle and clothing
en.body:
## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt and the displayed original reference assets in order. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Side-view motorcycle rider adapts the synthetic reference palette and blocky outline while changing the vehicle and clothing. More detailed pixels than the source; both wheels visible.

## Source and generation

The source provides an original prompt; this production uses the separately recorded working prompt. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#transfer-a-visual-style). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.

zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

使用本次实际提交的提示词，并按展示顺序加入原创参考图。修改提示词或底图后属于未验证的新变体。

## 观察结果

摩托骑士沿用原创参考图的配色和块状轮廓，同时更换车辆与服装。双轮完整可见，像素细节比参考图更密。

## 来源与生成

来源公开原提示词；本次使用单独记录的制作提示词。[来源](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#transfer-a-visual-style)。来源帖互动数不代表本次新生成案例的热度。

本例使用内置 GPT Image 工具生成。工具未返回精确模型 ID；GPT Image 2.6 是调研主题，不作为本次输出的已验证版本声明。使用的参考图均为本项目新生成。
